[Default]{.arg-key} `"sample_id"`
:::

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}

`--var_gene_names`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.var column containing gene names. By default, use the index.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--var_input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
.var column containing highly variable genes. By default, do not subset genes.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_labels`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Key in adata.obs for label information. Categories will automatically be
converted into integer categories and saved to adata.obs['_scvi_labels'].
If None, assigns the same label to all the data.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_size_factor`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Key in adata.obs for size factor information. Instead of using library size as a size factor,
the provided size factor column will be used as offset in the mean of the likelihood.
Assumed to be on linear scale.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_categorical_covariate`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Keys in adata.obs that correspond to categorical data. These covariates can be added in
addition to the batch covariate and are also treated as nuisance factors
(i.e., the model tries to minimize their effects on the latent space).
Thus, these should not be used for biologically-relevant factors that you do _not_ want to correct for.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--obs_continuous_covariate`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Keys in adata.obs that correspond to continuous data. These covariates can be added in
addition to the batch covariate and are also treated as nuisance factors
(i.e., the model tries to minimize their effects on the latent space). Thus, these should not be
used for biologically-relevant factors that you do _not_ want to correct for.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--sanitize_ensembl_ids`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to sanitize ensembl ids by removing version numbers.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean`

[Default]{.arg-key} `true`
:::
::::
:::::

### SCVI options

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="columnheader"}
Description
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="columnheader"}
Attributes
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_hidden_nodes`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of nodes per hidden layer.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `128`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_dimensions_latent_space`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Dimensionality of the latent space.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `30`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--n_hidden_layers`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Number of hidden layers used for encoder and decoder neural-networks.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `2`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--dropout_rate`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Dropout rate for the neural networks.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`double`

[Default]{.arg-key} `0.1`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--dispersion`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Set the behavior for the dispersion for negative binomial distributions:

- gene: dispersion parameter of negative binomial is constant per gene across cells
- gene-batch: dispersion can differ between different batches
- gene-label: dispersion can differ between different labels
- gene-cell:  dispersion can differ for every gene in every cell
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"gene"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"gene"`, `"gene-batch"`, `"gene-label"`, `"gene-cell"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--gene_likelihood`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Model used to generate the expression data from a count-based likelihood distribution.

- nb: Negative binomial distribution
- zinb: Zero-inflated negative binomial distribution
- poisson: Poisson distribution
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"nb"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"nb"`, `"zinb"`, `"poisson"`
:::
::::
:::::

`--encode_covariates`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to concatenate covariates to expression in encoder
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_false`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--deeply_inject_covariates`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Whether to concatenate covariates into output of hidden layers in encoder/decoder.
This option only applies when n_layers > 1. The covariates are concatenated to

:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--use_observed_lib_size`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Use observed library size for RNA as scaling factor in mean of conditional distribution.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`boolean_true`
:::
::::

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}

Metric logged during validation set epoch.

:::

Minimum change in the monitored quantity to qualify as an improvement, i.e. an absolute change of less than min_delta, will count as no improvement.

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/integrate/scvi/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/integrate/scvi);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/integrate/scvi/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
